speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — answer the amber one (v4, reshot on 4.8.5)
description: v4. Every live-action beat reshot on 4.8.5 with the launch plan's fixed opening: the top-middle cell turns amber ON CAMERA and the app's own preset chime sounds on that frame, the camera pushes into it in one continuous move, and the answer lands before ten seconds. See mulmoterminal-60s-v4-NOTES.md.
